description: This source file defines the code-behind for the Leaderboard page in an online examination system. It handles page load events, user session validation, database access to retrieve user info, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Leaderboard ASP.NET page, managing user session validation, database access for user info, and page navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; verifies user session, retrieves user semester info from database, and stores it in session; redirects to login if session is invalid.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Placeholder for leaderboard button click event; currently no implementation.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout by clearing session info and redirecting to login page.
